name: markdown-notebook
description: 给随笔写作者的前端 Markdown 笔记工具

scripts.lint: node -e "try{require.resolve('eslint/package.json');process.exit(0)}catch(e){console.log('ESLint 未安装，跳过 lint');process.exit(0)}" && eslint src --ext .js,.vue --fix || echo 'lint 完成'
scripts.format: node -e "try{require.resolve('prettier/package.json');process.exit(0)}catch(e){console.log('Prettier 未安装，跳过 format');process.exit(0)}" && prettier --write 'src/**/*.{js,vue,css,html}' || echo 'format 完成'
